description.short: Rich, brisk mid-grown tea with a smooth caramel undertone, bridging the intensity of coastal teas with highland perfume
description.overview: A powerhouse tea-growing province in the wet southwest, centered around Ratnapura, the ancient 'City of Gems' famed for sapphire and ruby mining.
description.aroma: Sweet caramel, dark honey, warm spice
description.taste: Full-bodied, moderately brisk, marrying the strength of lowlands with the sweetness of mid-hills
description.processing: Plucking → withering → orthodox rolling → full oxidation → drying

history.origin: Sabaragamuwa has been world-renowned for centuries for alluvial gem mines surrounding Ratnapura, attracting traders across the Indian Ocean.
history.development: Tea estates developed extensively along lush river basins and mid-elevation hills, providing versatile teas for commercial blenders.
history.modern: One of Sri Lanka's largest tea-producing regions, providing a steady supply of high-grade mid-grown tea for export.
interestingFacts: Ratnapura, the capital of Sabaragamuwa, translates to 'City of Gems' and is one of the world's most famous ruby and sapphire mining centers, creating an extraordinary dual agro-mining heritage.
Mid-grown Ceylon teas from Sabaragamuwa are prized for their versatility, retaining deep color and smooth flavor both hot and iced.
